item.title: My Journey with MIT DeepTraffic: Ranking #1
item.description:
Back in early 2017, I had the incredible opportunity to participate in MIT’s 6.S094: Deep Learning for Self-Driving Cars competition—DeepTraffic. Hosted via the official MIT DeepTraffic Simulator, it was an exhilarating experience that marked a significant milestone in my journey with AI and autonomous driving technology.

This competition proved to be the ultimate catalyst for my tech career: it earned me a tuition waiver for the Udacity Self-Driving Car Engineer Nanodegree, put my social handle on the map, and eventually led to NVIDIA AI following my Instagram account.
